content_scope: Raw normalized source chunks retained from live Qdrant; graph answer records are not supplied.

protocol.context_token_count: No verified Anthropic tokenizer available here. Log exact characters, UTF-8 bytes and whitespace terms; actual whole-prompt/completion tokens come only from provider usage.
protocol.duplicate_document: Both distinct round windows retained in round order within one shared formatted-document limit
protocol.initial_query: original English bytes; unique first 48 Unicode alphanumeric terms of length >=2 after fixed stoplist; quoted OR
protocol.merge: Reciprocal rank fusion constant 60; source identity (collection,point_id); stable source-identity tie order

methods.C: one lexical retrieval then one answer call
methods.D: initial lexical retrieval, one follow-up-query call, second retrieval, one answer call

protocol.output_cap_note: No synthetic record cap. Provider max_tokens/length failures are retained, with empty records on a length stop.
protocol.passage: Expand a query-matching FTS5 snippet into a bounded source-text window; preserve source identity and offset
protocol.population_completeness: Corpus existence, lexical match count, selected context and requested-answer completeness are distinct. Finite retrieval cannot certify full requested populations.
protocol.retrieval_engine: SQLite FTS5 BM25, existing unicode61 remove_diacritics 2 index
protocol.reuse: Read-only source corpus only; no prior variants, outputs, task selection or reader protocol reused.
protocol.source_cutoff_reason: Retained live-Qdrant text snapshot lacks a verified identity/content/cutoff equality witness to the frozen TTL graph.
